verses.text: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

segments.text: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger,
Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.

segments.text: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away:
O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.

verses.text: My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?

segments.text: My soul also is sore troubled:
And thou, O Jehovah, how long?

verses.text: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness’ sake.

segments.text: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul:
Save me for thy lovingkindness’ sake.

verses.text: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?

segments.text: For in death there is no remembrance of thee:
In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?

verses.text: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

segments.text: I am weary with my groaning;
Every night make I my bed to swim;
I water my couch with my tears.

verses.text: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.

segments.text: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief;
It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.

verses.text: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

segments.text: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity;
For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.text: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.

segments.text: Jehovah hath heard my supplication;
Jehovah will receive my prayer.

verses.text: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.

segments.text: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled:
They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
